definition: s_n is the share of the depth-n survivor mass on columns whose cycle monodromy is the central translation z or a four-cycle; it is layer_record's self_sufficient_mass_fraction at depth n+1, so computing s_n needs the layer n+1 route table.

validation.survivor_mass_lemma: asserted by the imported column_masses on every old phase at every column of every layer listed here, including the index 5 control

scope: Finite observations on the layers listed. A positive s_n at finitely many layers is not a lower bound on s_n and decides neither uniform nor individual mortality. The index 5 rows are the known-answer control: that family has a complete uniform mortality certificate.
